combo_label: Moving House × Herbs & Spices × Roald Dahl

entries.clue: Swap the big family place for somewhere smaller once the children have gone
Formal word on the paperwork for the person parting with the house
Ticket winner who demands a trained squirrel and goes down the rubbish chute
Top-hatted confectioner who hid five golden tickets inside his bars
Woven roost up a tree where the winged Gregg family pass a wretched night
Braggart passenger who claims a hundred legs and a boot for each, aboard the fruit
Yellowing documents that once proved a house was yours, a role the register now fills
Fiery red powder from a long thin dried chilli, shaken sparingly into devilled eggs
Feathery frond laid over cured salmon, and the flavour in a jar of gherkins
Soft Italian leaf torn over tomato and mozzarella, and pounded into green pesto
